args.title: checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 after failed health checks
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in production. Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent release previously healthy in production) across all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west. Rollback verified (status: rolled_out). Requires investigation into root cause of v2.3.1 health check failures before re-deployment.

trace.final:
Done. Here's what I did:

1. **Reviewed the release history**: v2.3.1 was failing health checks; the most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.
2. **Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0** across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — rollback verified as rolled out.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the failures and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer.

The incident remains open for on-call to investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 health check failures before it's re-deployed.

Done. Here's what I did:

1. **Reviewed the release history**: v2.3.1 was failing health checks; the most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.
2. **Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0** across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — rollback verified as rolled out.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the failures and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer.

The incident remains open for on-call to investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 health check failures before it's re-deployed.
